parameters.name: products
parameters.description: Finite set of product types, indexed by p

parameters.name: stages
parameters.description: Set of required process stages {A, B}

parameters.name: machines_stage_a
parameters.description: Set of machines eligible for stage A

parameters.name: machines_stage_b
parameters.description: Set of machines eligible for stage B

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Planning horizon over which the plan is evaluated

parameters.name: raw_material_cost
parameters.description: Raw-material cost per unit of product p

parameters.name: unit_selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling price of product p

parameters.name: processing_time_stage_a
parameters.description: Unit processing time of product p on machine m for stage A

parameters.name: processing_time_stage_b
parameters.description: Unit processing time of product p on machine m for stage B

parameters.name: machine_hours_capacity
parameters.description: Available effective machine-hours on each machine over the planning horizon

parameters.name: machine_full_capacity_cost
parameters.description: Operating-cost parameter associated with full-capacity operation of each machine

parameters.name: eligibility_set
parameters.description: Eligible machine set for each product and stage

parameters.name: demand_limit
parameters.description: Optional demand or sales-limit parameter for each product in generalized instances

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Total quantity of product p produced and sold

variables.name: assigned_quantity_stage_a
variables.description: Quantity of product p routed to machine m for stage A

variables.name: assigned_quantity_stage_b
variables.description: Quantity of product p routed to machine m for stage B

variables.name: machine_hours_used
variables.description: Total effective machine-hours used on each machine

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit achieved by the production plan

constraints.name: nonnegativity_of_decision_variables
constraints.description: All production, routing, machine-hours, and profit variables are nonnegative continuous quantities.
constraints.formula: x_p\ge 0,\; x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A}\ge 0,\; x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B}\ge 0,\; u_m\ge 0,\; \Pi\ge 0

constraints.name: machine_eligibility_restriction
constraints.description: Assignments for each product and stage may use only machines in the corresponding eligibility set.
constraints.formula: x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A}=0\quad \forall p\in\mathcal P,\; \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf A}\setminus \mathcal E_p^{\mathsf A};\qquad x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B}=0\quad \forall p\in\mathcal P,\; \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf B}\setminus \mathcal E_p^{\mathsf B}

constraints.name: machine_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Machine-hours consumed on each machine must not exceed available effective-hours capacity.
constraints.formula: u_m=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\tau_{p,m}^{\mathsf A}x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A}\quad \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf A};\qquad u_m=\sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\tau_{p,m}^{\mathsf B}x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B}\quad \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf B};\qquad u_m\le H_m\quad \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf A}\cup\mathcal M_{\mathsf B}

constraints.name: stage_flow_consistency
constraints.description: For each product, the quantity completed through stage A must equal the quantity that proceeds to stage B.
constraints.formula: \sum_{m\in\mathcal E_p^{\mathsf A}} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A}=\sum_{m\in\mathcal E_p^{\mathsf B}} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B}=x_p\quad \forall p\in\mathcal P

constraints.name: two_stage_processing_order
constraints.description: Each product must pass through stage A followed by stage B before being considered finished.
constraints.formula: x_p = \sum_{m\in\mathcal E_p^{\mathsf A}} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A} = \sum_{m\in\mathcal E_p^{\mathsf B}} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B} \quad \forall p\in\mathcal P

constraints.name: production_balance_stage_a
constraints.description: The total quantity of each product assigned to stage A across all eligible machines equals the produced quantity.
constraints.formula: \sum_{m\in\mathcal E_p^{\mathsf A}} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A}=x_p\quad \forall p\in\mathcal P

constraints.name: production_balance_stage_b
constraints.description: The total quantity of each product assigned to stage B across all eligible machines equals the produced quantity.
constraints.formula: \sum_{m\in\mathcal E_p^{\mathsf B}} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B}=x_p\quad \forall p\in\mathcal P

constraints.name: machine_hours_definition_stage_a
constraints.description: Machine-hours used on each stage A machine equal the processing time-weighted sum of assigned quantities.
constraints.formula: u_m = \sum_{p\in\mathcal P} \tau_{p,m}^{\mathsf A} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A} \quad \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf A}

constraints.name: machine_hours_definition_stage_b
constraints.description: Machine-hours used on each stage B machine equal the processing time-weighted sum of assigned quantities.
constraints.formula: u_m = \sum_{p\in\mathcal P} \tau_{p,m}^{\mathsf B} x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B} \quad \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf B}

constraints.name: machine_capacity_limit_stage_a
constraints.description: Machine-hours used on each stage A machine may not exceed its available effective-hours capacity.

constraints.name: machine_capacity_limit_stage_b
constraints.description: Machine-hours used on each stage B machine may not exceed its available effective-hours capacity.

constraints.name: eligibility_zeroing_stage_a
constraints.description: Assignments to ineligible stage A machines are fixed to zero.
constraints.formula: x_{p,m}^{\mathsf A} = 0 \quad \forall p\in\mathcal P,\; \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf A}\setminus \mathcal E_p^{\mathsf A}

constraints.name: eligibility_zeroing_stage_b
constraints.description: Assignments to ineligible stage B machines are fixed to zero.
constraints.formula: x_{p,m}^{\mathsf B} = 0 \quad \forall p\in\mathcal P,\; \forall m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf B}\setminus \mathcal E_p^{\mathsf B}

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit, using revenue minus raw-material costs and a linear machine operating-cost approximation obtained by scaling each machine's full-capacity operating cost by its utilized-hour fraction.
final_objective.formula: \Pi = \sum_{p\in\mathcal P}\left(\pi_p - c_p^{\mathrm{raw}}\right)x_p - \sum_{m\in\mathcal M_{\mathsf A}\cup\mathcal M_{\mathsf B}} \frac{F_m}{H_m}u_m
